test_title: PYST 6: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

A elephant (1) / was seen wandering (2) / on the road (3) / late at night (4).
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the indefinite article "**A**" before the noun "**elephant**."
 
• The word "elephant" begins with a vowel sound (/ε/), so grammatical rules dictate the use of the article "**An**" instead of "A".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**An elephant**," ensuring grammatical correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**An elephant** was seen wandering on the road late at night."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2: "was seen wandering" **– This part is grammatically correct and appropriately uses the passive voice followed by a present participle.
 
• **3: "on the road"** – This part is grammatically correct and uses the appropriate preposition "on" for a surface like a road.
 
• **4: "late at night."** – This part is grammatically correct and uses the standard idiom for specifying this time of day.
